views.caption: All modules of one strut laid out on the cutting mat: the strut core (rod with the electronics bay base and its board), two motor modules, the bay lid and two end caps with covers.
views.purpose: all modules of one strut laid out

camera.name: L/a
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: The same modules seen from the other side of the mat.
views.purpose: the layout from the other side

camera.name: L/b
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: The strut taken apart along its rod, in the order the parts go on: end cap, motor module, strut core with the bay lid beside it, motor module, end cap.
views.purpose: exploded along the rod, front

camera.name: X/a
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: The same exploded layout seen from the other side.
views.purpose: exploded along the rod, back

camera.name: X/b
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: First step, before: the strut core, and a motor module that slides onto one end of the rod.
views.purpose: step 1 before

camera.name: ST1b
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: First step, after: the motor module slid onto the rod and seated at its place, next to the bay.
views.purpose: step 1 after: the +z module at its place (axial position, roll)

camera.name: ST1a
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Second step, before: the second motor module beside the other end of the rod.
views.purpose: step 2 before

camera.name: ST2b
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Second step, after: both motor modules on the rod; the bay is still open.
views.purpose: step 2 after: the -z module at its place (axial position, roll)

camera.name: ST2a
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Third step, before: the open bay, and the bay lid beside it.
views.purpose: step 3 before

camera.name: ST3b
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Third step, after: the bay lid seated on the bay.
views.purpose: step 3 after: the lid seated (lid orientation)

camera.name: ST3a
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Fourth step, before: two end caps whose covers have the same colour, beside the two rod ends.
views.purpose: step 4 before

camera.name: ST4b
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Fourth step, after: both end caps pushed onto the rod ends; the strut is complete.
views.purpose: step 4 after: the finished strut

camera.name: ST4a
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: The assembled strut, seen from the side opposite the lid.
views.purpose: assembled, from behind

camera.name: V/1
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: The assembled strut resting on its other side.
views.purpose: assembled, resting on its other side

camera.name: V/2
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: The assembled strut, other side, from above.
views.purpose: assembled, other side from above

camera.name: V/3
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Looking along the rod at one end of the assembled strut.
views.purpose: end view of one end, about along the rod

camera.name: V/4
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Looking along the rod at the other end of the assembled strut.
views.purpose: end view of the other end

camera.name: V/5
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Close view: a motor module next to the bay on the assembled strut.
views.purpose: the gap between a motor module and the bay

camera.name: V/6
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Close-up before the lid goes on: the battery lead of a motor module runs into the open bay, towards its socket under the controller board.
views.purpose: the battery lead of a motor module running into the open bay towards its socket (the plug itself sits under the controller board: not visible from any side)

camera.name: C/1
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Close-up: an end cap pushed on until it meets the motor module.
views.purpose: an end cap against the motor enclosure (-z)

camera.name: C/2
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Close-up: one end of the seated bay lid, next to a motor module.
views.purpose: the lid's end notch straddling the rod

camera.name: C/3
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: Three assembled struts in the cell's cradle; each strut has one pair of cover colours: red, green, blue.
views.purpose: three struts in the cradle

camera.name: CR/a
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: The three struts in the cradle from the other side.
views.purpose: three struts in the cradle, other side

camera.name: CR/b
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: A motor module standing on its outer end: its inner end and the side that faced down before.
views.purpose: a motor module standing on its outer end

camera.name: BK/a
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV

views.caption: An end cap with its cover, resting on the cover: the open end that goes onto the rod.
views.purpose: an end cap resting on its cover, mouth up

camera.name: BK/b
camera.world: mat frame of the album's scenes (m); camera axes OpenCV
